items.description: Image Occlusion Enhanced is an add-on for the spaced repetition flashcard app Anki. It allows you to create flashcards that hide parts of an image to test your knowledge of that hidden information.

items.title: glutanimate/cloze-overlapper
items.description: Facilitates memorizing enumerations, lists, or any other type of sequential information by breaking the sequence up into cards where each item serves as the context cue for the next.

items.title: eshapard/AnkiHabitica
items.description: Anki 2 add-on for use with Habitica. Places a progress bar on the bottom of the review screen and scores a Habitica habit when the progress bar reaches the end. Also shows your health, exp, and mana stats as percentages to the right of the progress bar.

items.title: glutanimate/anki-addons-misc
items.description: This repository contains a collection of the small but useful Anki add-ons. For the more detailed table of contents, please see the descriptions of anki-addons-misc.

items.title: CravingCrates/AnkiCollab-Plugin
items.description: The AnkiCollab-Plugin enables users to create and share Anki flashcard decks collaboratively, streamlining the card creation process and allowing for professional revisions to improve deck quality.

items.title: krassowski/Anki-Night-Mode
items.description: This plugin adds the function of night mode, similar that one implemented in AnkiDroid.

items.title: roxgib/anki-contanki
items.description: Add-on enabling controller to review cards.

items.title: glutanimate/unified-remote-anki
items.description: A simple custom remote for Anki. Review cards while on a treadmill or across the room.

items.title: glutanimate/note-organizer
items.description: Extends Anki's card browser with an easy-to-use dialog that provides the user with a multitude of different ways to organize and restructure their note collection. Actions supported by the add-on include changing the note order, inserting new notes at specific positions, and the ability to duplicate notes alongside their scheduling.

items.title: jefdongus/insert-symbols-anki-addon
items.description: Insert symbols as you type.

items.title: glutanimate/colorful-tags
items.description: Set custom color for sidebar tags.

items.title: glutanimate/html-cleaner
items.description: Cleans and minifies HTML content of the current field, removing extraneous tags and attributes copied over from apps like Word, Chrome, etc.

items.title: glutanimate/advanced-previewer
items.description: Extends Anki's card previewer with such features: preview multiple cards at once; review cards from the previewer; show question or answer side by default.

items.title: glutanimate/highlight-search-results
items.description: Highlight search results in browser.

items.title: glutanimate/sequence-inserter
items.description: Allows you to define lists and sequences which can later be referenced in your cards through a special tag syntax.

items.title: glutanimate/sticky-searches
items.description: Adds a number of quick-toggles to the Browser search bar that allow you to preserve specific search parameters across multiple searches, so that you do not have to type them in repeatedly.

items.title: sillsdev/flashgrab
items.description: Add-on for pulling flashcard data (one-way sync) from XML.

items.title: gregorias/anki-image-scaler

items.title: sillsdev/flashgrid
